newsitem.title: USA: Roadmaster to cut debt with sale proceeds.
newsitem.headline: Roadmaster to cut debt with sale proceeds.

text.p: Roadmaster Industries Inc said on Friday it would use proceeds from the sale of its bicycle business to repay its outstanding debt and invest in the toy and fitness product businesses.
Brunswick Corp said in a separate statement it paid $198 million for Roadmaster's bicycle unit, including the Flexible Flyer line of sleds and wagons.
Roadmaster said it successfully completed its tender offer to repurchase its 11.75 percent senior subordinated notes due 2002.
Under the terms of the Brunswick agreement, Roadmaster will sell the Roadmaster trademark to that company and adopt a new corporate name at its next shareholders' meeting, it said.
The remaining Roadmaster Sporting Goods Group will retain the Flexible Flyer and other trademarks for use in the company's toy and fitness categories, the company said.
